The '''CZ Wrist-Mounted Flame Projector''' was a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]]. It cost eight hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] when available and weighed about one [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]]. It was a thin wandlike-weapon meant to be attached to the back of a person's wrist with its fuel canister attached to the weapon by a tube. The weapon's fuel canister cost around thirty credits and was usually stored on the user's belt.

At one point, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used a heavily modified CZ attached to his suit of [[Armor/Legends|battle armor]].
